verdict.rationale: Brex Travel and expense docs show pieces of this workflow — bookings carry policy metadata (brex-docs-6), corporate cards integrate with the platform (brex-docs-20/21), and receipts auto-match to expenses (brex-docs-7/brex-docs-27) — and the Travel product page claims to "simplify travel with global inventory and auto-enforced expense policies on one platform" (brex-docs-39). However, no evidence explicitly describes a trip/itinerary object that automatically aggregates bookings, card transactions, and receipts into a single itinerary-linked expense report for the employee. Missing for 10: explicit itinerary/trip-report generation feature, documentation of automatic booking-to-card-to-receipt linkage within one report, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of this consolidated view.
